    Representing integral projective classes #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.ProjectiveClass.exists_sub {R : Type u} [Ring R] (g : ProjectiveClass R) :
    ∃ (P : FiniteProjective R) (Q : FiniteProjective R), of P - of Q = g

    Every class is a difference of classes of two finite projective modules.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.ProjectiveClass.exists_twoTerm {R : Type u} [Ring R] (g : ProjectiveClass R) :
    ∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.projectiveClass = g

    Every integral projective class is the class of a two-term complex.
